title: Platform Auth Token Envelope
description: Frozen JWT payload for platform.auth-token-envelope/0.1.0. Embeds platform.auth-claims/1.1.0 (unchanged). Mint must normalize AuthClaims issuedAt/expiresAt to whole-second UTC so iat/nbf/exp NumericDate boundaries match AuthClaims validation exactly. Nested authClaims.correlationId is mint-time opaque issuance correlation only — not per-request Gateway correlation. AuthClaims $ref resolves by bundling packages/contracts/schemas/platform-auth-claims.v1.1.0.json (contentHash fb518834be897c32574df5f7235704fdb0de708bd3da1b48fc448246e3eca567) — do not fetch $ref over the network at runtime. Access-token jti is not single-use. Phase-1 iss must not end with '/'. Discovery URL = iss + '/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server'.

iss.description: Absolute PACI issuer URI (environment-specific). Phase-1 root issuers must not end with '/'. Discovery URL = iss + '/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server'.

aud.description: Must equal AuthClaims.audience as a set

iat.description: RFC 7519 NumericDate; equals unix seconds of mint-normalized AuthClaims.issuedAt (whole-second UTC)

exp.description: RFC 7519 NumericDate; equals unix seconds of mint-normalized AuthClaims.expiresAt (whole-second UTC)

jti.description: RFC 4122 UUID identifying this access token for correlation/audit; multi-request use allowed while valid (not a single-use ticket)

https://linktrend.dev/claims/auth.description: Exact frozen AuthClaims 1.1.0 object (bundled sibling schema). Nested correlationId is mint-time opaque issuance correlation only; per-request Gateway correlation uses an independent header/field (proposed X-Request-Id), not this claim.
